Package qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedinformation

Class AdvancedInformation

java.lang.Object
javafx.stage.Window
javafx.stage.Stage
qupath.ext.omero.gui.browser.advancedinformation.AdvancedInformation
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.event.EventTarget
public class AdvancedInformation extends javafx.stage.Stage
Window displaying OMERO annotations of an OMERO entity. OMERO annotations are not similar to QuPath annotations. Rather, they represent metadata associated with OMERO entities.

Annotations are displayed within several panes. Some annotations use a FormPane, while others use an InformationPane.
